items.project: The Unexpected Al Marjan Island Hotel & Residences
items.title: Almal tops out The Unexpected Al Marjan Island as works pass 50%
items.summary: Superstructure and concrete works are complete on the 422-unit hotel and residences project operated by Palladium Hotel Group, with overall progress above 50%. Work now moves to facade, MEP and interior fit-out.

items.title: ALA Developments breaks ground on Havencia in DLRC
items.summary: Construction has started on the 286-unit Havencia, offering studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments. Handover is targeted for Q2 2028.
